_note: Shared pattern vocabulary for deep dives. Use these IDs in findings.patterns; new IDs (type:slug) are allowed and show up as 'new' until added here.

loop.loop:collect-sell-upgrade: Collect items or currency, sell, buy upgrades that collect faster
loop.loop:steal-from-bases: Players raid each other's bases for items (Steal a Brainrot style)
loop.loop:egg-hatch-gacha: Spend currency on eggs/crates for random-rarity pets or units
loop.loop:luck-roll: Roll for random rarity (auras, items) with luck boosts
loop.loop:hit-for-drops: Hit, swing or shoot targets that drop randomized rewards
loop.loop:base-income-idle: Owned items generate income over time at your base
loop.loop:run-and-escape: Run a course or escape a hazard to reach rewards (Escape Tsunami style)
loop.loop:grow-and-harvest: Plant, wait, harvest, sell (Grow a Garden style)
loop.loop:fight-and-level: Fight enemies or players to gain XP, stats and gear
loop.loop:task-shift: Complete job or shift tasks against a threat (horror/job games)

ui.ui:left-rail-buttons: Vertical rail of big icon buttons on the left (shop, pets, rebirth)
ui.ui:shop-button-glow: Shop or offer button pulses or glows to pull attention
ui.ui:daily-reward-on-join: Daily reward or streak popup shown on join
ui.ui:rarity-colour-coding: Consistent colour per rarity across UI
ui.ui:floating-number-popups: Numbers pop out of the world on reward (+150, x2)
ui.ui:progress-bar-to-next: Visible bar toward the next unlock or rebirth
ui.ui:index-collection-book: Collection or index showing what is left to find

vfx.vfx:rarity-beam: Light beam or aura colour matching rarity on drop or reveal
vfx.vfx:screen-shake-impact: Camera shake on big hits or rare drops
vfx.vfx:particle-burst-reward: Particle burst when a reward is granted
vfx.vfx:trail-to-counter: Collected items fly or trail into the currency counter
vfx.vfx:anticipation-charge: Visible charge-up before the reveal or impact
vfx.vfx:mutation-glow: Glow or material change marking a mutated or special item

sfx.sfx:rising-pitch-combo: Pitch rises with repeated gains or combos
sfx.sfx:rarity-sting: Distinct sting for rare drops, bigger for higher rarity
sfx.sfx:purchase-cash-register: Cash or confirm sound on purchase
sfx.sfx:alert-announce: Server-wide announcement sound (someone got a rare)

monetization.monetization:auto-pass: Pass that automates the core action
monetization.monetization:extra-storage: Pay for more slots or storage
monetization.monetization:revive-or-respawn: Pay to revive or keep progress on death

retention.retention:rebirth-multiplier: Reset progress for a permanent multiplier

onboarding.onboarding:arrow-guided: Arrows or beams guide the first actions without a tutorial screen
onboarding.onboarding:first-reward-under-10s: First reward within 10 seconds of spawning
onboarding.onboarding:no-guidance: Player dropped in with no guidance

social.social:server-announcements: Rare finds announced to the whole server
social.social:leaderboards: Visible leaderboards in world or UI
social.social:group-reward: Reward for joining the group or liking
